provenance.author: dnd-diceroll project agents (Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5) for the repository owner
provenance.license: Project-owned original work; same terms as this repository
provenance.origin: Authored by script in Blender from the owner-approved Vigil look (issue #38) and the #140 gate-1 decisions; textures are r001 swatches (project-owned) or procedural; no third-party or downloaded content

recipe.method: Authored in Blender by script (build_kit_r002.py): translucent card with per-vertex opacity in COLOR_0.a

parameters.units: metres at true scale for a 150 cm cell
parameters.pivot: base centre of a 2.2 x 2.2 m card leaning back about 15 degrees (top toward -X)
parameters.sampling: Linear, 8 px wrapped padding per atlas region

settings.importer: Interchange glTF via Content/Python/import_dark_fantasy_theme.py, explicit reviewed reimport (#145 phase 2)
settings.material: translucent card material: texture x COLOR_0.rgb, opacity = COLOR_0.a (no glow); two-sided geometry already doubled, depth write off
settings.texture_filter: trilinear with anisotropic 8, mips generated, never nearest
settings.texture_compression: default (sRGB, mips); no nearest or editor-icon compression
settings.lods: exempt: under ~1k triangles or a translucent card (no LOD exports)
settings.collision: none (presentation only; blocking comes from gameplay data)
settings.vertex_colour: COLOR_0 VEC4 normalised uint16 (RGB tint, A opacity)
settings.axes: metres, +X forward, Z up (glTF Y-up export)
